items.en: What was the main goal of your research?

items.uz: Maqsadimiz bu hodisaning sabablarini aniqlash edi.
items.en: Our goal was to identify the causes of this phenomenon.

items.uz: Biz sifat va miqdoriy tahlillarni birlashtirdik.
items.en: We combined qualitative and quantitative analyses.
Did your results match what you expected?

items.uz: Qisman, ammo ba'zi kutilmagan topilmalar ham bo'ldi.
items.en: Partially, but there were also some unexpected findings.

items.uz: Hatto bitta kutilmagan natija ham butun nazariyani o'zgartirishi mumkin.
items.en: Even one unexpected result can change the entire theory.

items.uz: Faqat qo'shimcha tadqiqotlar bu savolga aniq javob berishi mumkin.
items.en: Only additional research can give a clear answer to this question.
I wish you luck with your future research.
Thank you for the presentation, I'm ready for questions.
